plugins.name: plan-review-loop
plugins.description: Closed-loop plan review on ExitPlanMode. Pick a backend per session (Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, codex, or Gemini 3.1 Pro via agy); only probe-verified ones are offered; autoswe reviews locally. Denies plan exit on P0/P1 findings; loop closes when the plan is clean.

plugins.name: bash-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse(Bash) hook that evaluates every shell command against a configurable rule set. Blocks destructive git ops, filesystem-nuking commands, untrusted curl-pipe-to-shell patterns, and identity-management changes. Rules are user-editable.

plugins.name: subagent-context-injector
plugins.description: SubagentStart hook that injects project context (CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md, git state, top-level structure) into Plan and Explore subagents so they boot with full project awareness instead of cold.

plugins.name: precompact-context-keeper
plugins.description: PreCompact hook that injects CLAUDE.md + a tiny git-state summary as a systemMessage just before compaction so the post-compaction model still has the project framing.

plugins.name: posttooluse-bash-audit
plugins.description: PostToolUse(Bash) hook that appends every executed Bash command (timestamp + session id + 200-char summary) to a local audit log. Stays local, fail-open.

plugins.name: branch-warn
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that emits 'on branch X' once per hour as a systemMessage. Catches the 'wait, I should be on a feature branch' footgun without nagging.

plugins.name: stop-session-check
plugins.description: Stop hook that surfaces a session-end completion checklist (uncommitted changes, branch ahead of remote, repo-type-specific test/deploy hints). Blocks the stop when there are uncommitted changes or unpushed commits.

plugins.name: putty-bridge
plugins.description: Generate a Windows PuTTY .reg + tmux snippet for remote tmux + Claude Code: UTF-8 + UTF8linedraw, true colour, deuteranopia-friendly dark palette, native copy/paste (right-click pastes, Shift+drag in tmux mouse-mode auto-copies via PuTTY's local selection), 50k scrollback, secure defaults. No PuTTY GUI clicks.

plugins.name: command-discovery
plugins.description: PostToolUse(Bash) hook that watches for a failed CLI invocation (an unknown/typo'd subcommand) and returns a did-you-mean suggestion via additionalContext, so the model self-corrects on the next turn instead of guessing again. The command inventory is configurable so it works with any CLI vendor, not just one hard-coded tool.

plugins.name: quota-advisory
plugins.description: Stop hook that surfaces a one-line advisory when the active usage-tracking block (via `ccusage` or a compatible CLI) crosses a configurable high-water mark, nudging you to /compact. Best-effort, cached, and budget-capped so a slow or missing usage CLI never risks the Stop gate.

plugins.name: stop-memory-hygiene
plugins.description: Stop hook that watches the auto-memory MEMORY.md index (size, over-long lines, unlinked topic files) and suggests a prune as a non-blocking systemMessage, at most once per 24h per project. Never blocks a stop.

plugins.name: agent-fleet
plugins.description: Skills for running a multi-session agent fleet (operator, leader, dispatcher, workers) with gating, succession and liveness checks, plus codebase-scan, dependency-scan, PR CI watch, deploy health watch and release-readiness workflows. Runtime adapters for Herdr, Claude Code and Codex; external tools are optional and documented per skill.
